name: mockmate-all-in-one
description: All-in-one runner for MockMate (Frontend, Backend, and ML Service)

scripts.install:all: npm run install:frontend && npm run install:backend && npm run install:ml
scripts.install:ml: cd ml_service && python -m pip install -r requirements.txt
scripts.dev: npx concurrently -k -n "FRONTEND,BACKEND,ML_SERVICE" -c "cyan,magenta,green" "npm run dev:frontend" "npm run dev:backend" "npm run dev:ml"
